base_signal.name: IndMom_RSI_Residualized_v2
base_signal.formula: residual_t(i) = z_M07_t(i) - β_t · z_M18_t(i), where β_t = expanding-window pooled OLS on {(z_M07_s(i), z_M18_s(i)) : s ≤ t-1, i ∈ universe_s}. no-intercept. shift(1L) strict. burn-in 36 months. **frozen monthly param** (single β_t per month, not re-fit within month).

components.name: z_IndMom_M07
components.formula: cross-sectional Z-score of M07_IndMom at month t (Factor DB sd=1.000 proper, post-Fix 1 verified)

components.name: z_RSI_M18
components.formula: cross-sectional Z-score of M18_RSI at month t (Factor DB sd=1.000 proper)
components.direction: higher_better (registry, overbought=positive 표면적이나 mean-reversion regressor 역할)
components.note: RSI residualization의 본질은 RSI-neutrality — 잔차 양의 = 'IndMom 강하면서 RSI overbought 아님' → clean rotation opportunity

components.name: beta_t_expanding
components.formula_strict: β_t = Σ_{s ≤ t-1} Σ_i z_M07_{s,i} · z_M18_{s,i} / Σ_{s ≤ t-1} Σ_i (z_M18_{s,i})². pooled no-intercept OLS. strict shift(1L) lag (C1). burn-in 36 months (1990-01~1992-12 pre-PIT window).
components.expected_range: 0.05~0.20 (IndMom vs RSI 구조적 상관 낮음, V2 empirical 측정 필수)
components.V2_STRUCTURAL_BREAK_AUDIT: structural break 3구간 (2003 IT버블 해소 / 2008 GFC / 2020 COVID) 전후 β_t 변화 ≥ 0.05 검증 필수 + rank correlation between residual rank and M07 rank over full sample < 0.95 (잔차가 M07 원본 pure rescale이 아닌 실질 잔차임을 증명)
